import sys,json,time,random
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as s
# An almost 4096-link one-sided peeling chain, anchored in a 64-link core.
core=list(range(1,65))
chain=[1,2]+list(range(1000,5029))
paths=[]
for pos in range(0,len(chain)-1,62):
    p=chain[pos:pos+64]
    if len(p)>=2:paths.append(dict(path=p,count=1000000))
# Core paths stay unchanged through all the chain's peeling rounds.
for length in range(3,65):
    for pos in range(64):
        p=[1+(pos+j)%64 for j in range(length)]
        if len(paths)==2000 or sum(len(x['path']) for x in paths)+len(p)>40000:break
        paths.append(dict(path=p,count=1000000))
    else:continue
    break
order=[[1,2]]+[[i,i+1] for i in range(2,64)]+[[1,64]]
d=dict(version=1,ixps=[],rib=paths,priors=[],declared=[],order=order,queries=[])
t=time.perf_counter();r=s.solve(d);t=time.perf_counter()-t
print('long chain: seconds',t,'raw',sum(len(x['path']) for x in paths),'links',len(r.get('links',[])),'max round',max(x['round'] for x in r.get('links',[])))
assert len(r['links'])<=4096 and max(x['round'] for x in r['links'])>3000
